comparison_rule: Compare documented behavior. Lineup checkmarks are listed and then ignored for stage status.

dimensions.title: Ingress
dimensions.question: Inbound traffic into the workload or the host is observed or controlled, and the coverage of that path is stated.

dimensions.title: Egress
dimensions.question: Outbound agent or workload traffic is observed or controlled on the paths the product names.

dimensions.title: Host
dimensions.question: A host the customer enrolls carries the control even when the process skips the application wrap.

dimensions.title: Descendant lineage
dimensions.question: A child or further descendant is covered by the same observation or enforcement as its parent, and the record shows lineage instead of inferring it.

dimensions.title: Workload identity and integrity
dimensions.question: A workload identity, distinct from a process id, is consumed with an integrity statement. The product does not become the identity provider.

dimensions.title: Sequential limits
dimensions.question: A limit applies to one call or one policy decision before the next decision.

dimensions.title: Aggregate limits
dimensions.question: A limit sums bytes, calls, or spend across a window, and crossing it is explicit.

dimensions.title: Simulation
dimensions.question: Synthetic or demo evidence is labeled and stays out of operational totals.

dimensions.title: Canary
dimensions.question: A policy or release is exposed to a subset of workloads before the rest.

dimensions.title: Rollback
dimensions.question: A source, package, or schema rollback leaves already recorded evidence readable.

dimensions.title: Revocation
dimensions.question: Expiry or revocation removes the granted authority and leaves no expanded remainder.

dimensions.title: Evidence
dimensions.question: Observation or enforcement produces a durable record a later reader can scope.

dimensions.title: Independent verification
dimensions.question: A verifier outside the producing team can check the record without asking the producer to restate it.

dimensions.title: Health
dimensions.question: Product health is a separate channel from workload success, and a green value on one channel does not fill another.

dimensions.title: Coverage truth
dimensions.question: The product names what is covered and what is not, and partial coverage is not displayed as complete.

dimensions.title: Deployment
dimensions.question: The product is placed on a host and brought to a stated health under a recorded procedure.

dimensions.title: Removal
dimensions.question: The product and its local evidence can leave the host under a recorded procedure.

dimensions.title: Performance
dimensions.question: Startup, policy load, decision latency, connection latency, throughput, loss, backpressure, and recovery are measured on a named workload.

dimensions.title: Operational overhead
dimensions.question: CPU, memory, disk, evidence growth, and startup cost added by the product are measured against the same workload without it.
